layers.title: Fiction entity layer
layers.notes: Dedicated fiction-entity layer for novel characters, titles, and in-world named entities, kept separate from everyday/chat phrase seeds and general proper nouns.

sources.name: Cassotis curated fiction entities
sources.notes: Project-maintained fiction entity list for novel characters, titles, and in-world named entities, isolated from the daily/chat preferred-term path and from general proper nouns.

layers.title: Project-maintained proper noun layer
layers.notes: Dedicated general proper-noun layer kept separate from everyday/chat phrase seeds, fiction-specific names, and domain-specific vertical terminology.

sources.name: Cassotis curated proper nouns
sources.notes: Project-maintained general proper nouns for names, titles, organizations, brands, and other real-world named entities that should not share the everyday/chat preferred-term path.

layers.title: Computing vertical layer
layers.notes: Dedicated vertical terminology layer kept separate from everyday/chat phrase seeds.

sources.name: THUOCL IT subset
sources.notes: THUOCL IT subset used as a computing/domain terminology candidate layer.

sources.name: Cassotis curated computing terms
sources.notes: Project-maintained computing/domain terminology layer isolated from daily/chat phrase ranking.

layers.title: Gaming vertical layer
layers.notes: Dedicated gaming-title and gaming-lexicon layer kept separate from everyday/chat phrase seeds and from general proper nouns.

sources.name: Cassotis curated gaming terms
sources.notes: Project-maintained gaming terminology supplement for high-value game-related wording that should stay isolated from daily/chat preferred-term ranking.

sources.name: Wikidata zh video games
sources.notes: Chinese labels and aliases for video-game items from Wikidata Query Service, used as the main gaming-title/entity source.

sources.name: Wikidata zh video game series
sources.notes: Chinese labels and aliases for video-game series from Wikidata Query Service.

sources.name: Wikidata zh video game genres
sources.notes: Chinese labels and aliases for video-game genres from Wikidata Query Service.

sources.name: Wikidata zh game consoles
sources.notes: Chinese labels and aliases for game consoles from Wikidata Query Service.

sources.name: Wiktionary zh gaming lexical titles
sources.notes: Filtered Chinese Wiktionary titles that match gaming lexical heuristics, used as a lightweight gaming-lexicon supplement.

sources.name: Wikipedia zh gaming lexical titles
sources.notes: Filtered Chinese Wikipedia titles that match gaming lexical heuristics, used as a conservative gaming-lexicon supplement.

layers.title: Game development vertical layer
layers.notes: Dedicated game-development terminology layer built from Godot documentation titles, Wikidata engine terms, and a small project-maintained supplement.

sources.name: Cassotis curated game development terms
sources.notes: Project-maintained game-development terminology supplement kept separate from the daily/chat preferred-term path.

sources.name: Godot Docs zh-cn title index
sources.notes: Filtered Chinese Godot documentation titles used as the main game-development terminology source.

sources.name: Wikidata zh game engines
sources.notes: Chinese labels and aliases for game engines from Wikidata Query Service.

sources.name: Wiktionary zh game-development lexical titles
sources.notes: Filtered Chinese Wiktionary titles that match game-development lexical heuristics.

sources.name: Wikipedia zh game-development lexical titles
sources.notes: Filtered Chinese Wikipedia titles that match game-development lexical heuristics.

layers.title: Medicine vertical layer
layers.notes: Dedicated medical terminology layer built from MeSH-validated Wikidata entities plus a filtered THUOCL medical candidate source.

sources.name: Cassotis curated medical terms
sources.notes: Project-maintained medical supplement for high-value terms and explicit pinyin corrections that should stay isolated from daily/chat preferred-term ranking.

sources.name: MeSH descriptor catalog
sources.notes: Official MeSH descriptor catalog used as the medical concept whitelist for vertical medical import.

sources.name: Wikidata zh medical entities (MeSH-linked)
sources.notes: Chinese medical labels and aliases from Wikidata Query Service, kept only when the linked MeSH descriptor stays inside medical MeSH tree categories.

sources.name: THUOCL medical subset
sources.notes: Medical-domain candidate layer from THUOCL, kept separate from daily/chat phrase ranking and weighted more conservatively than the MeSH-validated medical entities.
